data: fresh 128 adaptive triplets only; previous 64-pair pilot and stress not pooled into primary
estimand: equal-weight average win-probability difference over the eight frozen adaptive opponent scenarios, not human-ladder win probability
primary_model: For each opponent scenario, categorical joint outcomes of A/B/C (8 binary patterns), independent symmetric Dirichlet prior with total mass 1 per scenario. Average posterior win probabilities with equal 1/8 scenario weights. Retain cross-arm dependence within a triplet.
normal_sensitivity: Descriptive normal-likelihood approximation to paired stratified mean, zero-centered Normal priors with SD 1,3,5,10 percentage points; report as sensitivity, not replace primary after seeing results.
decision: Use owner threshold; if no reply after a reasonable opportunity, use proposed 80%. Choose largest posterior expected win probability among candidates meeting primary P(candidate>A) threshold; assess all secondary results and disclose prior sensitivity. No claim of prospective preregistration or frequentist significance.
limitations: The model treats seeded matches as independent within each fixed opponent scenario; it does not model generalization beyond these teams and this opponent bot.
Prior sensitivity is part of the decision; an improvement probability is conditional on the model, not an unconditional probability that the deployed bot is stronger.
The adoption criterion is revised after the previous results at the owner request; the original failed frequentist gate remains recorded.
